mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% over the next month reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns in the following 20-day window.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than during the prior 20-day period with a similar FEDFUNDS level (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in employment (PAYEMS) of more than 20,000 jobs in a single month coincides with stronger consumer confidence and drives upward pressure on the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant correlation with the employment surprise (Spearman's rho < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by over 5% from the prior month indicates weakening aggregate demand, which tends to depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than the prior 20-day average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained double-digit decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) over three months reduces the market's inflation premium, lowering discount rates and supporting higher S&P 500 forward returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are flat or negative despite sustained CPIAUCSL declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 1-month moving average of FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.0% while UNRATE remains below 4%, the market anticipates future rate cuts, causing a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS MA(1) crosses above 2.0% and UNRATE < 4%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive relative to the pre-signal period (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in housing starts (not in the observable catalog, so skip) — instead: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a cooling labor market, which tends to weigh on equities over the next 60-day horizon.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically lower than during the prior 60-day period with similar UNRATE levels (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in both industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (not available — so use RSAFS as proxy for demand) by more than 10% in the same month creates dual demand weakness, predicting negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a deflationary regime (CPIAUCSL < 102), the market anticipates lower future inflation, reducing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are flat or negative despite sustained CPIAUCSL declines (t-test p > 0.05).
